items.title: fix(memory-lancedb): preserve capture progress through compaction (#1…
items.summary: fix(memory-lancedb): preserve capture progress through compaction (#131329) * fix(memory-lancedb): stop re-embedding old messages after cursor fingerprint eviction resolveAutoCaptureStartIndex's fallback to a full rescan from index 0 (when the cursor's tracked message fingerprint can no longer be found, e.g. after history compaction rewrites it) had no content-based guard against reprocessing messages the cursor already captured earlier in the same session. Once the fingerprint search missed once, every subsequent turn re-embedded surviving old messages from the start of history -- confirmed live as months-old conversation content being re-submitted to the embedding endpoint continuously, at roughly 1 call/second for hours. Track a bounded (20-entry) list of recently captured message fingerprints on the cursor and skip already-captured messages by content regardless of scan position, independent of resolveAutoCaptureStartIndex's position-based resume heuristic. Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Vk2cBRQdErwRtPea8VuhG6 * fix(memory-lancedb): track duplicate-checked messages so they aren't re-embedded The fingerprint guard added in the previous commit only marked a message as captured when db.store() ran. When findCleanDuplicateMemory found an existing match instead, the code skipped storing but never recorded the fingerprint, so a message whose embedding had already been computed and checked could still be re-embedded on a later fingerprint-miss rescan. Track the fingerprint whenever the embedding-consuming work for a message reaches a conclusion -- stored new or matched an existing duplicate -- since both are non-repeatable outcomes. * test(memory-lancedb): prove survivor suppression against real OpenAI embeddings + LanceDB ClawSweeper P1: the existing mocked-harness coverage for this fix (index.test.ts's 're-embeds an already-captured surviving message once its cursor fingerprint is evicted from history') spies on the embeddings client and LanceDB runtime directly -- it proves this module's own selection logic but not that a real configured plugin, real OpenAI embeddings endpoint, and real LanceDB storage agree on the same call count. Added a live case to the existing memory-lancedb.live.test.ts (gated on OPENCLAW_LIVE_TEST=1 + OPENAI_API_KEY, already exercising real OpenAI embeddings + real LanceDB for the store/recall/duplicate/forget flow) that reproduces the exact compaction scenario: turn 1 captures two facts, turn 2 simulates a real compaction where the tracked message evicted from history but an earlier, already-captured message survives verbatim ahead of one genuinely new fact. OpenAIEmbeddingCallCounter counts real POST requests to api.openai.com's /embeddings endpoint via a fetch wrapper (same established pattern as the openai-responses continuation live tests), so the assertion is on the real embedding provider's actual call count, not a spy. Confirmed this fails against the pre-fix production code (4 real embedding calls -- the surviving message really did get re-embedded against the live API) and passes with this branch's fix (3 calls). Proof, real run against api.openai.com + real LanceDB: $ OPENCLAW_LIVE_TEST=1 OPENAI_API_KEY=*** node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs scripts/test-live.mts \ extensions/memory-lancedb/memory-lancedb.live.test.ts ✓ memory plugin live tests > memory tools work end-to-end 21828ms ✓ memory plugin live tests > does not re-embed a surviving auto-capture message after real compaction 561ms Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 2 passed (2) * fix(memory-lancedb): preserve capture progress through compaction Track retained occurrences and completed text at the capture owner, serialize overlapping captures, and drain automatic capture before storage closes. Co-authored-by: Markus Hartung --------- Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger Co-authored-by: Markus Hartung

items.title: Microsoft 365驗證異常擴大，Exchange Online郵件與Teams等多項服務受影響
items.summary: 微軟於臺灣時間9月1日凌晨開始調查Exchange Online異常，隨後確認問題波及多項Microsoft 365服務。Exchange Online受影響最明顯，使用者可能遇到郵件收發延遲或失敗、登入錯誤、信箱搜尋異常及管理功能無法正常操作，微軟初步將問題指向服務用來處理使用者身分驗證的核心設定，事故也波及Microsoft Teams、OneDrive for Business、SharePoint Online、Microsoft Purview及Microsoft Defender XDR等服務。

items.title: FTC攜22州控告Amazon廣告拍賣「暗藏加價」逾7年
items.summary: 美國聯邦交易委員會（Federal Trade Commission，FTC）本周一（8/31）聯合阿拉斯加、亞利桑那、加州、科羅拉多、佛羅里達、華盛頓州等22州檢察長，向亞馬遜（Amazon）提起訴訟，指控其電商廣告拍賣機制長期暗藏隱形加價，涉及超過100萬名品牌與賣家，認為Amazon可能因此非法多賺逾200億美元。

items.title: 研究人員Nightmare Eclipse公開Nvidia記憶體中斷漏洞GreenSection
items.summary: 從今年4月開始多次公布微軟零時差漏洞的資安研究人員Nightmare Eclipse（Chaotic Eclipse），近期開始針對其他廠牌的系統挖掘零時差漏洞，其中包括存在於卡巴斯基、Avast防毒軟體的權限提升漏洞HardBreacher、PrettyPrague，該名研究員本週也揭露存在於Nvidia元件的零時差漏洞。

items.title: 駭客假冒《俠盜獵車手VI》外流遊戲檔案，散布惡意程式
items.summary: 遊戲《俠盜獵車手VI》（GTA VI）於近期傳出檔案外流消息後，駭客隨即利用玩家期待心理，藉由假冒的該遊戲外流檔案散布惡意軟體。這起事件的起因，是一位代號CyberLeek的爆料者於8月中旬陸續外洩該遊戲的影片與地圖，隨後網路上開始流傳號稱GTA VI完整遊戲內容的113GB ISO檔案。
